description: This Java enum defines different levels of password strength with associated properties and utility methods for conversion and representation.

classes.name: PasswordStrength
classes.description: An enumeration representing various password strength levels (Weak, Fair, Good, Strong, Very strong) with methods for string representation and value conversion.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the password strength level.

methods.name: getStrengthNum
methods.description: Returns the numerical value associated with the password strength level.

methods.name: fromValue
methods.description: Converts an integer value to the corresponding PasswordStrength enum, throwing an exception if the input is out of range.
